description: Set a 3D layer's Geometry Options: extrude and bevel text and shape layers (bevel style, bevel depth, hole bevel depth, extrusion depth) or bend footage and precomposition layers (curvature, segments). Extrusion needs the Advanced 3D or Cinema 4D renderer (set_comp_3d_settings). Values are keyframed when the property is animated or a time is given

bevelDepth.description: Bevel Depth in pixels (text and shape layers)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

extrusionDepth.description: Extrusion Depth in pixels (text and shape layers)

holeBevelDepth.description: Hole Bevel Depth, percent of Bevel Depth (text and shape layers)

layers.description: Which 3D layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

segments.description: Segments, the facets of a curved layer (footage and precomposition layers)

time.description: Seconds: set keyframes at this time. Omit to set the static value, or a keyframe at the current time when the property is already animated

name: set_geometry_options
title: Set Geometry Options
